name: ═══════════════ CAMERA WATCHDOGS (DOMAIN 612) ═══════════════
info:
## Camera Watchdogs (Flow 612)

Monitors each Tapo camera via `garden/camera/{slug}/health`.

- **Heartbeat:** ICMP ping from `camera-ping-watchdog.service` every **60 s** (`CAMERA_PING_INTERVAL_SEC`)
- **Timeout:** 3 minutes without `online`
- **Explicit offline:** immediate alert when ping publishes `offline`
- **No continuous ONVIF** — snapshots only on MQTT command
- **Alerts:** Telegram (transitions only), via flow 90 sender
